rows.section: Matching MHPSS Activities to the MSP

rows.section: Matching MHPSS Activities to the MSP
rows.en: • Help participants to map their activities using the MSP language.
rows.ne: • MSP मा प्रयोग गरिएको भाषा प्रयोग गरी आफ्ना गतिविधिहरूको नक्साङ्कन गर्न सहभागीहरूलाई सहयोग गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: • Help participants map their activities using the language used in the MSP.

rows.en: • Support participants in assessing the quality of their activities based on the MSP core actions. The learning activity is split into three parts:

rows.section: Matching MHPSS Activities to the MSP
rows.en: Part 1: Matching example activities to the MSP
rows.ne: भाग 1: उदाहरणका रूपमा दिइएका गतिविधिहरूलाई MSP सँग मिलान गर्ने
rows.bt: Part 1: Matching the activities given as examples with the MSP

rows.section: Matching MHPSS Activities to the MSP
rows.en: This part of the activity is about matching example activities to MSP activities so participants get familiar with the language used in the MSP and feel prepared to then match their own MHPSS activities with the MSP activities.
rows.ne: यस गतिविधिको यो भागमा उदाहरणका रूपमा दिइएका गतिविधिहरूलाई MSP गतिविधिहरूसँग मिलान गरिन्छ, जसबाट सहभागीहरू MSP मा प्रयोग गरिएको भाषासँग परिचित हुन्छन् र त्यसपछि आफ्नै MHPSS गतिविधिहरूलाई MSP गतिविधिहरूसँग मिलान गर्न आफू तयार भएको महसुस गर्छन्।
rows.bt: In this part of this activity, the activities given as examples are matched with MSP activities, through which participants become familiar with the language used in the MSP and then feel ready to match their own MHPSS activities with MSP activities.

rows.section: Matching MHPSS Activities to the MSP
rows.en: Explain that participants will be matching example activities to MSP activities.
rows.ne: सहभागीहरूले उदाहरणका रूपमा दिइएका गतिविधिहरूलाई MSP गतिविधिहरूसँग मिलान गर्नेछन् भनी व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Explain that participants will match the activities given as examples with MSP activities.

rows.section: Matching MHPSS Activities to the MSP
rows.en: Explain that one of the challenges faced by those working on the MHPSS response is the variation in the language used, which can lead to inconsistencies when mapping exercises are carried out or simply when information is exchanged between agencies and between sectors.
rows.ne: MHPSS प्रतिकार्यमा काम गर्नेहरूले सामना गर्ने चुनौतीमध्ये एउटा प्रयोग गरिने भाषामा हुने भिन्नता हो र यसले नक्साङ्कन अभ्यास गर्दा वा निकायहरूबीच र क्षेत्रहरूबीच सूचना आदानप्रदान मात्र गर्दा पनि असङ्गति निम्त्याउन सक्छ भनी व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Explain that one of the challenges faced by those working in the MHPSS response is the difference in the language used, and that this can lead to inconsistencies when carrying out a mapping exercise or even just exchanging information between agencies and between sectors.

rows.section: Matching MHPSS Activities to the MSP
rows.en: In addition to establishing what are the minimum activities in emergencies, the MSP can also provide a basis for common language and improved communication within the field of MHPSS.
rows.ne: आपत्कालीन अवस्था हुँदा न्यूनतम रूपमा गरिनुपर्ने गतिविधिहरू के हुन् भन्ने निर्धारण गर्नुका साथै MSP ले MHPSS को क्षेत्रमा साझा भाषा र सुधारिएको सञ्चारका लागि आधार पनि प्रदान गर्न सक्छ।
rows.bt: Along with determining what activities should be carried out at a minimum when there is an emergency, the MSP can also provide a basis for a common language and improved communication in the field of MHPSS.

rows.section: Matching MHPSS Activities to the MSP
rows.en: To confirm participants understand the exercise before distributing the cards, work through one example in plenary e.g. “Community workers support people with depression, anxiety and distress through a group psychological intervention (Group Problem Management +)”.
rows.ne: कार्डहरू वितरण गर्नुअघि सहभागीहरूले अभ्यास बुझेका छन् भन्ने पुष्टि गर्न, पूर्ण सत्रमा एउटा उदाहरण सबैसँग मिलेर अभ्यास गर्नुहोस्। उदाहरणका लागि: “समुदायमा काम गर्ने कार्यकर्ताहरूले [depression], [anxiety] र व्यथा भएका मानिसहरूलाई समूहमा गरिने मनोवैज्ञानिक हस्तक्षेप ([Group Problem Management +]) मार्फत सहयोग गर्छन्।”
rows.bt: Before distributing the cards, to confirm that the participants have understood the exercise, practise one example together with everyone in the full session. For example: “Workers who work in the community help people with [depression], [anxiety] and distress through a psychological intervention carried out in a group ([Group Problem Management +]).”
rows.note: Unvalidated practitioner draft; the named diagnoses and intervention remain in exact source English within square brackets.

rows.section: Matching MHPSS Activities to the MSP
rows.en: Once participants understand the exercise, divide them into small groups and distribute the cards.
rows.ne: सहभागीहरूले अभ्यास बुझेपछि, उनीहरूलाई साना समूहमा विभाजन गर्नुहोस् र कार्डहरू वितरण गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Once participants have understood the exercise, divide them into small groups and distribute the cards.

rows.section: Matching MHPSS Activities to the MSP
rows.en: You can use the same groups as the previous exercise and give each pair 1-2 cards or combine groups and give them 3-4 cards.
rows.ne: अघिल्लो अभ्यासकै समूहहरू प्रयोग गरी प्रत्येक जोडीलाई 1-2 कार्ड दिन सक्नुहुन्छ वा समूहहरू मिलाएर उनीहरूलाई 3-4 कार्ड दिन सक्नुहुन्छ।
rows.bt: You can use the same groups as in the previous exercise and give each pair 1-2 cards, or combine the groups and give them 3-4 cards.

rows.section: Matching MHPSS Activities to the MSP
rows.en: Give the groups 3-4 minutes per card.
rows.ne: समूहहरूलाई प्रत्येक कार्डका लागि 3-4 मिनेट दिनुहोस्।
rows.bt: Give the groups 3-4 minutes for each card.

rows.section: Matching MHPSS Activities to the MSP
rows.en: Ask participants to stick each example in the corresponding flipchart from the previous exercise.
rows.ne: सहभागीहरूलाई प्रत्येक उदाहरण अघिल्लो अभ्यासको सम्बन्धित फ्लिपचार्टमा टाँस्न लगाउनुहोस्।
rows.bt: Have participants stick each example onto the corresponding flipchart from the previous exercise.

rows.en: When participants are finished, move around

rows.en: Read aloud the examples and ask the participants if they think it is correctly placed.

rows.en: Discuss together, asking:

rows.en: You can adapt the examples to your context based on your knowledge of the activities that are being implemented, using a 4Ws or referral documents.

rows.bt: Based on the composition of the participants, you can have the following exercise done in small groups or individually.

rows.section: Matching MHPSS Activities to the MSP
rows.en: If there are multiple participants from the same organization, they can work together to match their programme activities (implemented and planned) to MSP activities.
rows.ne: एउटै संस्थाबाट धेरै सहभागी आएका छन् भने उनीहरूले आफ्ना कार्यक्रमगत गतिविधिहरूलाई (कार्यान्वयन गरिएका र योजनाबद्ध) MSP गतिविधिहरूसँग मिलाउन सँगै काम गर्न सक्छन्।
rows.bt: If several participants have come from the same organization, they can work together to match their programmatic activities (implemented and planned) with MSP activities.

rows.section: Matching MHPSS Activities to the MSP
rows.en: You can also create an inter-agency group for participants without colleagues in attendance or they can work individually.
rows.ne: सहकर्मीहरू उपस्थित नभएका सहभागीहरूका लागि तपाईंले संस्थाहरूबीचको समूह पनि बनाउन सक्नुहुन्छ वा उनीहरूले व्यक्तिगत रूपमा काम गर्न सक्छन्।
rows.bt: For participants whose colleagues are not present, you can also form groups across organizations, or they can work individually.

rows.section: Matching MHPSS Activities to the MSP
rows.en: • Check if participants have a good understanding of what constitutes an MHPSS activity and provide clarification if needed.
rows.ne: • केलाई MHPSS गतिविधि मानिन्छ भन्नेबारे सहभागीहरूले राम्रोसँग बुझेका छन् कि छैनन् भनी जाँच गर्नुहोस् र आवश्यक भएमा स्पष्ट पार्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: • Check whether participants have understood well what is considered an MHPSS activity and clarify if necessary.
rows.note: Removed the incorrect T163 annotation: the row uses MHPSS, not MSP. The Nepali wording is retained.

rows.section: Matching MHPSS Activities to the MSP
rows.en: • Check if participants have a good understanding of the MSP programme activities and clarify confusion, answer remaining questions if needed.
rows.ne: • सहभागीहरूले MSP का कार्यक्रमगत गतिविधिहरू राम्ररी बुझेका छन् कि छैनन् जाँच्नुहोस् र अन्योल स्पष्ट पार्नुहोस्; आवश्यक भएमा बाँकी प्रश्नहरूको उत्तर दिनुहोस्।
rows.bt: • Check whether participants have understood the MSP programmatic activities well and clarify any confusion; answer remaining questions if necessary.

rows.section: Matching MHPSS Activities to the MSP
rows.en: • Clarify that the MSP is not a comprehensive list of all feasible or effective MHPSS activities.
rows.ne: • MSP सम्भव वा प्रभावकारी सबै MHPSS गतिविधिहरूको विस्तृत सूची होइन भन्ने स्पष्ट पार्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: • Clarify that the MSP is not a comprehensive list of all possible or effective MHPSS activities.

rows.section: Matching MHPSS Activities to the MSP
rows.en: • Provide participants with an overview of the MHPSS activities that are being implemented, planned and possible programme gaps – with attention to the limitations imposed by the fact that not all organizations contributing to the MHPSS response in the context are present. Remind participants that there may be activities that are not included in the MSP. Those can be written on sticky notes and added to the ‘Activities not included in the MSP’ flipchart for discussion in plenary. Give participants 30 minutes to complete this part of the exercise.
rows.ne: • उक्त सन्दर्भमा MHPSS प्रतिकार्यमा योगदान गरिरहेका सबै संस्थाहरू उपस्थित नभएकाले उत्पन्न सीमितताहरूलाई ध्यानमा राख्दै, कार्यान्वयन भइरहेका तथा योजना बनाइएका MHPSS गतिविधिहरू र कार्यक्रममा हुन सक्ने कमीहरूबारे सहभागीहरूलाई झलक दिनुहोस्। MSP मा समावेश नभएका गतिविधिहरू पनि हुन सक्छन् भन्ने सहभागीहरूलाई सम्झाउनुहोस्। ती गतिविधिहरू टाँस्ने पर्चीहरूमा लेखेर पूर्ण सत्रमा छलफल गर्न ‘MSP मा समावेश नभएका गतिविधिहरू’ शीर्षकको फ्लिपचार्टमा थप्न सकिन्छ। अभ्यासको यो भाग पूरा गर्न सहभागीहरूलाई 30 मिनेट दिनुहोस्।
rows.bt: • Give participants an overview of MHPSS activities being implemented and planned and possible gaps in programming, taking into account the limitations arising from not all organizations contributing to the MHPSS response in that context being present. Remind participants that there may also be activities not included in the MSP. These activities can be written on sticky notes and added to the flipchart titled ‘Activities not included in the MSP’ for discussion in the plenary session. Give participants 30 minutes to complete this part of the exercise.
rows.note: Recurring workshop terms sticky notes, flipchart and plenary are absent from G-0.3; proposed nonclinical equivalents are listed in proposals.
